es: Resolver un caso final de entrada C1: interpretar lo implícito de un mensaje, responder con tacto y defender una postura con matiz.

teaching.en: I read the message twice to interpret its tone.
teaching.es: Leí el mensaje dos veces para interpretar su tono.
teaching.explanationEs: Interpretar es el primer paso: tono, registro y lo que se sugiere sin decirlo.
teaching.audioText: I read the message twice to interpret its tone.

teaching.en: Her polite email implied that I was late.
teaching.es: Su correo cortés daba a entender que yo llegaba tarde.
teaching.explanationEs: Imply + that + oración: sugerir algo sin decirlo; no se dice implied me.
teaching.audioText: Her polite email implied that I was late.

teaching.en: I understand your concern; nevertheless, I must decline the invitation.
teaching.es: Entiendo tu preocupación; sin embargo, debo rechazar la invitación.
teaching.explanationEs: Reconoce primero y rechaza después con decline y nevertheless: tacto y claridad.
teaching.audioText: I understand your concern; nevertheless, I must decline the invitation.

teaching.en: I firmly believe the price is fair, although I admit it is high.
teaching.es: Creo firmemente que el precio es justo, aunque admito que es alto.
teaching.explanationEs: Postura firme + admit: defiendes tu idea sin negar un punto débil.
segments: I firmly believe the price is fair,
although I admit it is high.
teaching.audioText: I firmly believe the price is fair, although I admit it is high.

teaching.en: A good reply shows nuance: it concedes a point and still defends a position.
teaching.es: Una buena respuesta muestra matiz: concede un punto y aun así defiende una postura.
teaching.explanationEs: Nuance es la combinación de concesión, cautela y firmeza.
segments: A good reply shows nuance: it concedes
a point and still defends a position.
teaching.audioText: A good reply shows nuance: it concedes a point and still defends a position.

teaching.en: She answered the complaint with tact and kept her position.
teaching.es: Respondió a la queja con tacto y mantuvo su postura.
teaching.explanationEs: Tact: decir lo necesario sin herir; no cambia tu posición.
teaching.audioText: She answered the complaint with tact and kept her position.

prompt.es: Escucha el mensaje y elige lo que implica la hablante.

She is inviting you to a party.
She is complaining politely about the noise.

prompt.es: Elige la respuesta con tacto a este mensaje de tu casero.

choices.text: Thank you for letting me know. I'm afraid that is a big rise; could we talk about it?
That is unfair. I refuse to pay.
OK.

feedback.es: Agradece, expresa el problema con un atenuador (I'm afraid) y propone hablar: es cortés y defiende tu postura.

prompt.es: Interpreta el mensaje: ¿qué quiere decir en realidad la vecina?

She politely implies that you forgot the bins last week.
She is asking you to buy new bins.

origin.text: Note from your neighbour: “Just a reminder that the recycling bins go out on Thursday. I'm sure it was simply forgotten last week.”

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué postura defiende la hablante.

choices.text: She rejects the plan completely.
She is unsure and asks for another plan.
She defends the plan while admitting a problem.

feedback.es: Admite un punto débil (not perfect) pero defiende el plan con firmeza: postura con matiz.

origin.audio: I admit the plan is not perfect, but I firmly believe it is the fairest option we have.

prompt.es: Completa: «Tengo que admitir que no es perfecto, pero es justo.»

feedback.es: Admit reconoce un punto débil sin renunciar a la postura.

origin.text: I must ___ that it is not perfect, but it is fair.

prompt.es: Responde al mensaje con tacto y defiende tu postura con matiz.

answer.text: Hi Sam, thank you for your message. I think you are saying that the cleaning is not shared fairly, and I understand why you feel that way. It is true that I have been out a lot this month, and I admit that some weeks you have done more than your part. However, I firmly believe the problem is partly my work schedule, because I finish late on most days and I am often too tired to clean. To some extent, that may explain why the flat looks worse than before. I'm afraid I cannot clean every day, but I would like to find a fair solution. Could we agree to make a weekly calendar? I could take the kitchen on Saturdays, and you could choose another task. What do you think? Let's review the plan in two weeks. Thanks again for being honest with me.
accepted: Hi Sam, thank you for your message. I think you are saying that the cleaning is not shared fairly, and I understand why you feel that way. It is true that I have been out a lot this month, and I admit that some weeks you have done more than your part. However, I firmly believe the problem is partly my work schedule, because I finish late on most days and I am often too tired to clean. To some extent, that may explain why the flat looks worse than before. I'm afraid I cannot clean every day, but I would like to find a fair solution. Could we agree to make a weekly calendar? I could take the kitchen on Saturdays, and you could choose another task. What do you think? Let's review the plan in two weeks. Thanks again for being honest with me.

Hello Sam, thanks for telling me how you feel. Your message suggests that I am not doing enough, and I can see why you are upset. Admittedly, I have not cleaned much lately, and I am sorry about that. Still, my new job means that I work late most evenings, so perhaps the real problem is time, not effort. I'm not sure a strict rule would help, but a simple calendar might. What if we share the tasks by day and I take the bathroom and the kitchen at weekends? We could try it for a month and then check whether it works for both of us. I hope that sounds fair, and thank you for being patient with me.

feedback.es: Una buena respuesta interpreta lo implícito, agradece, concede un punto, defiende la postura con cautela y propone un plan concreto.

Tu compañero de piso escribe: «Some of us seem to do all the cleaning while others are always out.» Escribe entre 110 y 150 palabras: interpreta lo que implica, agradece, reconoce un punto, defiende tu postura con cautela (tu horario de trabajo te deja poco tiempo) y propón un plan (un calendario) con un acuerdo concreto.
